company.name: Fireblocks
company.shortDescription: Fireblocks is a blockchain security service provider for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets.
company.description:
Fireblocks is a platform that protects digital assets in transit, focusing on protecting the transmission of customers' digital assets between exchanges, counter brokers, hot wallets, and cold stores.

Fireblocks enables banks, fintech, exchanges, liquidity providers, OTCs, and hedge funds to securely manage digital assets across a wide range of products and services. The technology consists of the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure.

productsAndServices.description: An infrastructure platform for building, securing, managing, and automating digital asset operations, including wallets, transfers, issuance, governance, and blockchain connectivity.
productsAndServices.name: Fireblocks Digital Asset Infrastructure Platform

productsAndServices.description: Wallet infrastructure for creating, securing, connecting, and managing digital asset wallets, including institutional custody and embedded wallet deployments.
productsAndServices.name: Fireblocks Wallets and Custody

productsAndServices.description: Infrastructure for sending, receiving, accepting, and orchestrating stablecoin payments across blockchains, payment rails, currencies, and financial counterparties.
productsAndServices.name: Fireblocks Payments Infrastructure

productsAndServices.description: A connectivity network linking digital asset businesses, financial institutions, liquidity providers, custodians, and payment participants for asset transfers and settlement.
productsAndServices.name: Fireblocks Network

productsAndServices.description: Tools for controlling, monitoring, and automating digital asset treasury operations across wallets, entities, blockchains, and counterparties.
productsAndServices.name: Fireblocks Treasury Management

productsAndServices.description: Infrastructure for issuing and managing tokenized assets, including smart contract operations, lifecycle workflows, custody, and transfers.
productsAndServices.name: Fireblocks Tokenization
